A. IS_PLAN (unary reasoning)

parameters.description: The reasoning that enumerates requirements or deliverables and assesses their completion status.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least two distinct requirements or deliverables.
For each identified requirement or deliverable, the reasoning states a satisfaction status, supporting evidence, or an explicit judgment of completion.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning gives only a general completion claim without per-requirement assessment.
The reasoning merely lists requirements without indicating whether each is satisfied.
The reasoning evaluates only a single requirement without a multi-requirement assessment.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFIES_MULTIPLE_REQUIREMENTS_WITH_COMBINED_CHECK
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning identifies multiple independent completion requirements, the action performs a combined check that gathers evidence for several of them, and the observation reports results sufficient to assess each identified requirement.

parameters.name: requirement_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that identifies multiple completion requirements or deliverables to be verified.

parameters.name: verification_action
parameters.description: The action performing a combined verification of several identified requirements.

parameters.name: verification_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting evidence corresponding to the multiple verified requirements.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning enumerates at least two distinct completion requirements or deliverables.
The verification action includes checks targeting those requirements, even if they are combined in one invocation.
The observation reports outcomes or evidence for each requirement sufficient to assess completion.
exclusion_conditions: The verification action checks only one requirement.
The reasoning does not identify multiple completion criteria.
The observation lacks evidence for at least one of the identified requirements.
